severe_findings.title: errata item 4 claims logs/src.diff is already LF / CRLF 0, but the file is UTF-16LE with BOM
claims_contradicted: main README section 3 line 41: '6,772 B, CRLF 0, LF 62, sha 12be6af5..., byte-identical to HEAD => already LF'
dde275c1 commit message item 4: 'logs/src.diff LF 复核（已 LF、字节未变）'
severe_findings.assessment: bytes/sha/byte-identical are correct; 'CRLF 0', 'already LF' and implied UTF-8 are false. LF=62 was the raw 0x0A byte count, which in UTF-16 includes low bytes of CJK code units, not line count. The batch's own 15-file encoding self-check does not include this file (7 modified + 8 new), so that self-check is not wrong; the item-4 audit conclusion is.
severe_findings.impact: evidence hygiene requirement (UTF-8/LF/no BOM) remains unmet and the errata record is factually wrong; does not affect the G-L2 verdict or any numeric evidence
severe_findings.fix: correct README section 3 / receipt field / artifact measurement to state UTF-16LE+BOM (not LF); Chief decides whether to normalize the historical evidence bytes (changes sha + manifest line) or to register it as a -text binary evidence file
